_label: SYNTHETIC hand-written oracles for the credit cap. Every expected value was worked out by hand from config/spend.yaml (headroom 10%, rounding step $0.05, variance threshold 25%) and the documented p_search web_search price ($0.005 a call, advanced mode, 10 results), not produced by the code under test.

within_cap._work: plan 10 calls x $0.005 expected = $0.050; +10% = $0.055; round up to $0.05 -> cap $0.10. 6 distinct paid calls = $0.030, plus 2 replays (free). advisory $0.050; variance -$0.020; |0.020| > 25% of 0.050 (0.0125) -> flag.

cap_reached._work: plan 2 calls x $0.005 = $0.010; +10% = $0.011; round up -> cap $0.05. Each call reserves $0.005: the 10th fits exactly ($0.050 <= $0.050), the 11th is refused (BudgetExceeded). advisory $0.010; variance +$0.04 -> flag.

extension._work: as cap_reached: cap $0.05, 10 paid calls; attended run requests an extension to $0.08, a person approves it (version 2). 4 more paid calls: spent $0.07; remaining $0.01; 70000 x 100 // 80000 = 87%. The extension version carries no breakdown, so the advisory figure is not measured.
